goals.result: One admitted lens supplies the live image, locator cone, viewed-tissue marker, five-ray tissue guide and lens section. Fixed whole-head inset retains the complete telescope.

Conforming reconstructed closure/soft transitions are rounded within 0.30 mm. Pure hard vertices and source meshes are unchanged. Discrete audits retain existing contacts without new/worsened extents. Specimen-specific synovial anatomy is unavailable.
Matched physical-lens views show smoother lower transitions. Acute recesses, reconstructed ridges and coarse hard/mixed silhouettes remain. Clinical photorealism is not achieved.

Documented 1.9 mm telescope, 63.1 mm working length, 30 degree direction and 65 degree field retain finite-volume checks. Cannula outer/lumen dimensions, seating/lens offset and registered skin portal remain unknown.
Insertion/withdrawal, pivot, roll, last-admitted contact stops and synchronized travel are verified. This is not clinical path safety or haptic validation.

Bone and disc stay rigid; inferior chamber co-moves. Tapered superior scalar compliance, geometric regional volumes and mass-conserving flow are implemented. Small jaw, anterior and distraction requests stop at reconstructed lining contact. Two soft-contact samples per small step are not continuous soft CCD. No CFD, FEM or natural disc-condyle trajectory is claimed.
